name: Molecular Cell Biology & Genetics
description: Lecture: introduction to tools of cell biology; architecture of prokaryotic and eukaryotic cells; DNA, RNA and genetic code; chromosomes and genome organisation- prokaryotes versus eukaryotes; molecular basis of inheritance including mendelian genetics and non-mendelian genetics. Genetic linkage and mapping in both bacteria and eukaryotes. DNA replication, mutations, DNA repair and genetic recombination; gene expression – transcription, RNA processing, epigenetics and translation. Control of evolution of genes and population genetics. Gene expression.; protein synthesis, processing, and regulation; proteostasis -protein turnover; cell cycle; non-coding RNA; cell renewal and cell death; molecular biology at the cutting edge; special topics in modern genetics including human genome project. Laboratory: visualization of prokaryotic and eukaryotic cells; understanding the requirements for cellular growth and culture; phases of cellular growth; chromosome staining in onion root tip cells and cell division; isolation of genomic DNA from multiple sources; restriction digestion to identify patterns; PCR; human blood antigen identification.
